en.question: Your service calls the Messages API with a set of tools. A response comes back with stop_reason set to "tool_use". What must your application do next to continue the conversation correctly?

options.text: Execute the requested tools and send a user turn containing matching tool_result blocks.
Append an assistant turn holding the tool output formatted as explanatory prose.
options.note: Prose loses the tool_use_id linkage, so the API cannot match result to request.

options.text: Resend the same request with tool_choice set to none so the model answers directly.
options.note: Forcing a direct answer discards the tool call the model determined it needed.

options.text: Run the tools and fold their output into the next user question as extra context.
options.note: Free-text context is not a tool_result, leaving the tool_use unanswered, which errors.

en.explanation: The protocol is specific: a tool_use block must be answered by a tool_result block carrying the matching tool_use_id, and it travels in a user turn. Anything else breaks the linkage the API expects.
